purpose: Exploratory donor-resolved cluster audit; cell-type assignments are unavailable. No macrophage/HSC replication claim.
matrix_encoding: plain integer MatrixMarket inside gzip tar despite .gz member suffix
marker_source: Kim et al., DOI 10.1016/j.jhep.2024.10.044; marker expression is descriptive and does not establish purity or author labels.
normalization: Sum raw counts per donor and original cluster, divide by all 27200-gene counts; log2(1+CPM). No pooled-cell inference.

statistics.effect: difference of donor mean log2(1+CPM), MASH minus NORMAL; not a fold change
statistics.test: two-sided exhaustive donor-label permutation conditional on group sizes
statistics.multiple_testing: BH over all 36 prespecified cluster-gene slots; untestable slots contribute p=1
statistics.bootstrap: 5000 independent within-group donor percentile bootstrap; 95% intervals descriptive, not simultaneous
statistics.loo: remove one donor from each group, all combinations
statistics.exploratory_flag: q<0.05; not an acceptance criterion for biological or clinical validation

MASL: descriptive only, never pooled with NORMAL
annotation_gate: No confirmatory compartment comparison until primary annotation or independently validated assignments available. No cluster assigned by SEMA4D/PLXNB2 signal or matching published compartment size.
limits: Observational MASH comparison; no alcohol-specific or decompensated cirrhosis claim.
Different study/accessions from prior cohorts; donor overlap not independently excluded.
Common reported pipeline and feature list, not an independent FASTQ reprocessing or proof of absent batch effects.
amendment: Technical label correction: source CSV uses NASH/NAFL, not MASH/MASL. Version1 completed count audit but returned zero eligible disease donors and zero tests. No gene values or valid contrasts inspected before correction. Original files retained; no success criterion changed.
